newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Golf Trust of America.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Golf Trust of America.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co analyst James Wilson said in a research note he initiated coverage of Golf Trust of America Inc with a buy recommendation.

-- "We believe that Golf Trust of America has established an excellent model for effecting acquisitions of upscale, highly profitable golf courses. We expect GTA to generate the fastest FFO (funds from operations) rate among all REITs in our coverage, through acquisition-driven portfolio growth and strong internal growth," according to the note.
-- Shares were off 1/4 to 25-1/4 in late morning American Stock Exchange trade.
